title: Cellular and transcriptional profiling of the adult human utricle and its early response to ototoxic damage
core_idea: Generate a cellular and transcriptional map of the adult human utricle—focusing on sensory and non-sensory (supporting) cells—and characterize early transcriptional responses to aminoglycoside-induced ototoxic damage using patient-derived bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing to inform regenerative strategies for balance disorders.
tldr: Map cell types and early damage-responsive transcriptional states in the adult human utricle via bulk and single-cell RNA-seq to support development of regenerative therapies for balance loss.
